method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); the rules in one module, the questions in a seat module importing them; two regulative rules (Act ss 61(1A), 62(6) with reg s 11A) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Safety, Rehabilitation and Compensation Regulations 2019 (F2019L00423), Compilation No. 2, compilation date 1 April 2024 (register id F2024C00663), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/F2019L00423.txt (text sha256 16b7b30f02ba2389da9345c7c49f35fa182f47cac88606bee4c5af13d5e4e24b per its .meta.json), retrieved 2026-10-19; with the words of the Safety, Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 1988 the Regulations fill in (ss 4, 7(8)-(9), 8(9B)-(9G), 61(1A), 62(6)), Compilation No. 82 (C2026C00285). The formula of regs ss 9 and 11 is lost from the deposit (NOTES.md finding 1).

seat: the claimant: the injured employee of the Commonwealth, a Commonwealth authority, an Entity or a licensed corporation who claims compensation under the Act (srcr-seat.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run srcr-rules.l4 ; l4 run srcr-seat.l4 ; l4 run srcr-cases.l4
checks.result: 140 assertions written, 140 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07, after the fix for the s 7(8) commencement)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: The claimant's provisions. In: s 5 (as used); s 6 and Schedule 2; s 7 with Act s 4(1) medical treatment (i); s 8A with Act s 7(8), (9) and s 36; ss 8-11 with Act s 8(9B), (9C), (9E), (9F); s 11A with Act ss 61(1A), 62(6) and s 37; ss 19(2), (3)(a), (b), 21(2), (3)(a)-(c), (7), 22(1)(d), 25(1), 27(2), (3)(a), (b), 28(1)(d), (3), 30(8), (11), 31(1) as they reach the claimant. Out: ss 1, 3; Part 3 (provider renewal and fees); Part 4 Division 1 and Schedule 1 (licence applications); ss 18, 26; what licensees owe Comcare, premiums and pending proceedings (ss 19(2)(c), 21(2)(d), (4)-(6), (8), 27(3)(c)); guarantee money (ss 20, 24, 30(1)-(7), (9)-(10)); the preserved licence and the Commission's end-of-period determination (ss 22, 23, 28, 29, as facts only); s 32; ss 33-35. Reasons in NOTES.md.
